metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: A quintessential warm ensemble comedy with lovable characters and optimistic humor, echoing the comforting and uplifting vibes of Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: A fast-paced, comforting workplace sitcom with outstanding group chemistry and high-energy humor, perfect for fans of Scrubs and Community.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: Classic British nerd comedy and absurd workplace situations that beautifully blend the dry wit of Peep Show with the tech setting of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A hilarious mockumentary about vampires navigating modern life, matching the chaotic energy of It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A wildly funny, nostalgic, and chaotic comedy about teenagers in 1990s Northern Ireland, sharing the brilliant family/ensemble dynamics of Malcolm in the Middle.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A heartwarming and quirky animated family sitcom that perfectly captures the gentle, character-driven humor of King of the Hill and The Simpsons.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: An early British pop-culture-obsessed comedy masterpiece from Edgar Wright, ideal for fans of Community's meta-humor and Peep Show's flat-sharing dynamic.

metas.name: The Inbetweeners
metas.description: If you loved PhoneShop and Peep Show, you will adore this cringeworthy and laugh-out-loud funny look at teenage awkwardness in the UK.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: A delightfully heartwarming riches-to-rags comedy about a dysfunctional family finding community, appealing directly to fans of Arrested Development and Ted Lasso.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: A rapid-fire, highly cynical, and meta workplace comedy that aligns perfectly with the sharp, quick writing of Arrested Development.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: A slick, hilarious adult animation about dysfunctional secret agents, matching the clever banter of Rick and Morty and Arrested Development.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: A brilliant, chaotic British game show where comedians perform absurd tasks, perfect for the relaxed, hilarious entertainment style of Gogglebox.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: A quirky, low-key musical comedy with dry, deadpan humor that fans of Peep Show and quirky sitcoms will love.

metas.name: Ghosts
metas.description: A whimsical, heartwarming British comedy about a young couple sharing their inherited estate with a chaotic bunch of historical ghosts.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A delightful mockumentary school sitcom filled with heart, charm, and easy-going humor, perfect for fans of New Girl.

metas.name: Shrinking
metas.description: Co-created by the team behind Ted Lasso, this comedy-drama offers a heartfelt, funny, and comforting look at life, grief, and therapy.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A whimsical, heartwarming pirate comedy with a lovable misfit crew, capturing the feel-good energy of Ted Lasso and ONE PIECE.

metas.name: Resident Alien
metas.description: A highly entertaining sci-fi comedy about an awkward alien trying to blend into a small town, matching the quirky humor of Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Stath Lets Flats
metas.description: A chaotic, hilarious British cringe comedy about an incompetent letting agent, sharing the DNA of PhoneShop and Peep Show.

metas.name: Fresh Meat
metas.description: Created by the team behind Peep Show, this hilarious and awkward comedy follows six university students sharing a house.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A criminally underrated, fast-paced corporate satire that matches the inventive, meta-humor style of Community and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A cult classic comedy following a group of cynical caterers, featuring a stellar cast and dry humor akin to Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Nathan for You
metas.description: An incredibly funny, high-concept reality comedy where a consultant offers absurd business advice, perfect for fans of cringe humor.

metas.name: Gravity Falls
metas.description: A clever, funny, and mystery-filled animated series with a lot of heart, perfect for fans of Futurama and light sci-fi adventure.

metas.name: Broad City
metas.description: A high-energy, hilarious comedy about two best friends navigating life in New York, capturing the chaotic fun of New Girl.

metas.name: The Venture Bros.
metas.description: A brilliant, long-running animated comedy that parodies retro pop culture and sci-fi, sharing the clever writing of Futurama.

metas.name: Friday Night Dinner
metas.description: A chaotic and comforting British sitcom about a family's weekly dinner, matching the family dynamic of Malcolm in the Middle.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A heartwarming, low-stakes family sitcom that provides pure comfort viewing, perfect for relaxing after a long day.

metas.name: Detroiters
metas.description: A pure, joyful buddy comedy about two best friends running an ad agency, capturing the infectious warmth and humor of Scrubs.

metas.name: Acapulco
metas.description: A bright, colorful, and incredibly charming bilingual comedy set in a 1980s resort, perfect for fans of Ted Lasso's optimism.

metas.name: The Great British Baking Show
metas.description: The ultimate wholesome comfort television, offering a relaxing, competitive but sweet viewing experience similar to Gogglebox.

metas.name: Cougar Town
metas.description: Created by the mind behind Scrubs, this fast-paced sitcom about a tight-knit, wine-loving group of friends is perfect comfort viewing.

metas.name: Bored to Death
metas.description: A quirky, charming comedy about a writer who moonlights as an unlicensed private detective, capturing the spirit of Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Father Ted
metas.description: A legendary, absurd Irish comedy about three priests living on a remote island, matching the eccentric character humor of British sitcoms.

metas.name: This Country
metas.description: A mockumentary about two cousins in rural England, offering brilliant, low-key character comedy similar to Peep Show.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: A biting, fast-paced political comedy with razor-sharp dialogue, matching the cynical and quick-witted humor of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt
metas.description: A vibrant, fast-paced comedy full of absurd situations and infectious optimism, created by the team behind 30 Rock.

metas.name: Extraordinary
metas.description: A quirky, hilarious British comedy set in a world where everyone gets a superpower except the protagonist, matching the fun energy of Community.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: From the creator of One-Punch Man, this visually stunning anime combines incredible action, great comedy, and a deeply wholesome heart.

metas.name: Mythic Quest
metas.description: A workplace comedy set in a video game studio, co-created by the Always Sunny team and sharing its sharp, comedic tone.
